mapper.select: select plan_id from user_plan_selections where user_id = #{userId}

select d.id, d.day_number, d.title, greatest(1, ceil(coalesce(sum(coalesce(e.video_duration_seconds, 60) * greatest(de.set_count, 1)), 60) / 60)) duration_minutes, count(de.id) exercise_count, case when exists ( select 1 from user_plan_day_completions pc where pc.user_id = #{userId} and pc.plan_id = #{planId} and pc.day_number = d.day_number ) then 'COMPLETED' else 'PENDING' end item_status from training_plan_days d left join training_plan_day_exercises de on de.plan_day_id = d.id left join exercises e on e.id = de.exercise_id where d.plan_id = #{planId} group by d.id, d.day_number, d.title, d.sort_order order by d.sort_order, d.day_number

select de.id, de.exercise_id, e.name exercise_name, de.repetitions, de.set_count, de.sort_order from training_plan_day_exercises de join exercises e on e.id = de.exercise_id where de.plan_day_id = #{planDayId} order by de.sort_order, de.id

select p.id, p.title, p.sessions_per_week, p.cycle_days, p.description, p.subtitle, p.cover_image, p.detail_image, p.home_image, p.level, p.training_scene, p.session_minutes, p.benefit_one, p.benefit_two, p.benefit_three, count(d.id) day_count from training_plans p left join training_plan_days d on d.plan_id = p.id where p.active = true group by p.id, p.title, p.sessions_per_week, p.cycle_days, p.description, p.subtitle, p.cover_image, p.detail_image, p.home_image, p.level, p.training_scene, p.session_minutes, p.benefit_one, p.benefit_two, p.benefit_three, p.sort_order order by p.sort_order, p.id
select count(*) from training_plan_days where plan_id = #{planId} and day_number = #{dayNumber}
mapper.insert: insert into user_plan_day_completions(user_id, plan_id, day_number) values (#{userId}, #{planId}, #{dayNumber}) on duplicate key update completed_at = current_timestamp(3)
